title: 青岚风云 第148章 韩崇告辞而去剑无痕主动来投青岚风云 第147章 李长老的担忧大玄王朝到来
slug: 凡人修仙我能无限重生
content_zh:
青岚风云第148章韩崇告辞而去，剑无痕主动来投
“看来，这大玄王朝太子是真心要支持咱们。八百民夫、三百车石料，还有阵法师！这可是一笔不小的家底啊。”
李长老站在帐篷旁边看着浩浩荡荡开进来的马车队伍，捋着胡须，笑呵呵地说道。
“太子说了，这只是他们的第一批物资，稍后还会还二批、第三批，只要我们这边需要，他就算掏空国库，砸锅卖铁，也要支援我们。”
林越站在他身旁，望着那些正在卸载石料的士兵和民夫，微微一笑道。
“林长老，你到底是怎么说服太子殿下的。据我所知，大玄王朝向来抠门，上次青岚宗请他们支助点香火钱，都被他们一口拒绝了。”李长老道。
“你那是没有找对人。我要是猜的没错，你找的应该是景王殿下吧！？景王崇尚武力，一向瞧不起我们这些土里土气的修士，你找他肯定会碰个钉子的。”
“林长老。你真是洞若神明，老夫之前的确找的是景王殿下。我听朝廷上的人说，太子羸弱，朝局由景王说了算，所以我才找到了他，哪知道他是那样小气的人。”
“李长老，你看太子送来的这些物资，是多么的大手笔啊，你还觉得他是个羸弱的人吗？呵呵呵，你怕还不知道吧，景王已经成了阶下囚，如今大玄王朝已经是太子说了算啦！”
“我不知道啊。林长老，你看说来听听，到底是怎么回事？”李长老迫不及待的追问道。
林越遂将之前在灵州城发生的事情讲述给他听了，李长老听后哈哈大笑，不住地赞叹，“这位太子爷啊，还真是深藏不露，连老夫都被他骗了。”
林越笑了笑。
他将八百民夫被分成四组，每组负责一段墙体或基座的辅助工作，配合青岚宗弟子们施工。
随行的十名阵法师是国子监灵器司出身的，年纪都不大，林越将他们安排在楚昊那组修建阵法基座。他们像是对阵法和灵脉有着天然的亲近，和楚昊简单交流了几句，便迅速进入了状态。
“林长老，太子殿下还让末将带一句话。这第一批人马物资只是开头。后续还有三批，正在筹集中，预计两个月内陆续到位。殿下说，正气长城的事，他牢记心上，不会让北境这边断了供应。”
安排好物资之后，韩崇没有急着离开，而是来到林越面前，朝他拱手说道。
林越拱手道：“替我谢过太子殿下。”
韩崇抱拳回礼：“末将还有公务在身，就不多留了。林长老，告辞！”
“后会有期！”林越道。
韩崇点了点头，又检查了一遍物资卸货情况，确认一切都交接清楚后，便带着少数几名护卫翻身上马，沿着来路策马远去，很快就消失在官道尽头那片土黄色尘烟中。

大玄王朝的车队刚走，天空便传来一阵破空声响。林越抬头看去，原来是在青岚宗做人质的天剑宗弟子剑无痕。他正御剑而来，穿过云层，很快便落在了林越面前。
“林……林长老！”剑无痕见到林越，还是有点拘谨，似乎是很害怕的样子。
青岚风云第148章韩崇告辞而去，剑无痕主动来投
“贱兄！你怎么来了？”
content_en:
Qinglan Fengyun Chapter 148 Han Chong said goodbye and left, Jian Wuhen took the initiative to surrender
"It seems that the prince of the Daxuan Dynasty really wants to support us. Eight hundred civilians, three hundred carts of stones, and an array master! This is quite a fortune."
Elder Li stood next to the tent and looked at the mighty carriage team coming in, stroking his beard and said with a smile.
"The prince said that this is only their first batch of supplies, and they will return the second and third batches later. As long as we need it, he will support us even if he empties the treasury and sells iron."
Lin Yue stood beside him, looking at the soldiers and civilians who were unloading stones, and smiled slightly.
"Elder Lin, how did you convince His Highness the Crown Prince? As far as I know, the Daxuan Dynasty has always been stingy. The last time the Qinglan Sect asked them to support the incense money, they refused." Elder Li said.
"You didn't find the right person. If my guess is correct, you should be looking for His Highness King Jing, right!? King Jing advocates force and has always looked down on us rustic monks. You will definitely run into trouble if you look for him."
"Elder Lin. You are really insightful. I was indeed looking for His Highness Prince Jing before. I heard people in the court say that the Crown Prince is weak and Prince Jing has the final say in the affairs of the court, so I found him. Who knew he was such a stingy person."
"Elder Li, look at how generous the supplies sent by the prince are. Do you still think he is a weak person? Hahaha, I'm afraid you don't know yet. King Jing has become a prisoner. Now the prince has the final say in the Daxuan Dynasty!"
"I don't know. Elder Lin, come and see what's going on?" Elder Li asked impatiently.
Lin Yuesui told him what happened in Lingzhou City. Elder Li laughed loudly and kept praising, "This prince is so secretive that even I was deceived by him."
Lin Yue smiled.
He divided the eight hundred civilians into four groups, each group was responsible for the auxiliary work of a section of wall or base, and cooperated with the construction of the Qinglan Sect disciples.
The ten formation masters who accompanied him were from the Spiritual Weapons Department of the Imperial Academy, and they were all young. Lin Yue arranged for them to join Chu Hao's group to build the formation base. They seemed to have a natural affinity with battle techniques and spiritual veins. They exchanged a few words with Chu Hao and quickly got into the mood.
"Elder Lin, His Highness the Crown Prince also asked the general to bring a few words. This first batch of supplies for the people and horses is just the beginning. There will be three more batches, which are being collected and are expected to be delivered within two months. His Highness said that he will keep the matter of the Great Wall of Justice in mind and will not let the supply of the northern border be cut off."
After arranging the supplies, Han Chong did not leave in a hurry, but came to Lin Yue, raised his hands to him and said.
Lin Yue cupped his hands and said, "Thank you, His Royal Highness, for me."
Han Chong cupped his fists and returned the salute: "The general is still on official duties, so I won't stay any longer. Elder Lin, take your leave!"
"See you later!" Lin Yue said.
Han Chong nodded, checked the unloading of materials again, and after confirming that everything was handed over clearly, he got on his horse with a few guards, rode away along the way he came, and soon disappeared into the khaki dust and smoke at the end of the official road.
As soon as the Daxuan Dynasty's convoy left, there was a burst of sound in the sky. Lin Yue looked up and saw that it was Jian Wuhen, a disciple of the Tianjian Sect who was serving as a hostage in the Qinglan Sect. He was coming with his sword, passed through the clouds, and soon landed in front of Lin Yue.
"Lin...Elder Lin!" Jian Wuhen was still a little cautious when he saw Lin Yue, and seemed to be very scared.

"Brother bitch! Why are you here?"
